themes.quote: Mortgage banking contributed to non-interest income through origination, servicing and sales activities
Capital Markets segment provides interest rate derivatives and other financial services to clients
We actively manage our investment securities portfolio to optimize yield while managing interest rate and credit risk
Commercial real estate portfolios include owner-occupied and investor real estate mortgages and construction loans
Consumer portfolio includes residential first mortgages, home equity loans and lines of credit, and credit card receivables
We continue to actively manage our investment portfolio, including reducing our residential mortgage-backed securities holdings
Our commercial real estate portfolio faces significant stress, requiring active management of nonperforming assets and restructured loans
We are focused on maintaining stable deposit relationships and managing deposit costs in a competitive environment
We maintain strong capital ratios and liquidity positions to support our business operations and meet regulatory requirements
We continue to monitor asset quality closely, including increased provisions for loan losses reflecting macroeconomic conditions
owner-occupied CRE portfolio challenges reflected in increased nonaccrual loans and higher loan loss provisions
continued pressure on deposit margins as we compete for core deposits in a challenging funding environment
adjusted investment portfolio positioning in response to interest rate environment and liquidity management needs
increased delinquencies in credit card and home equity portfolios reflecting consumer stress and economic uncertainty
net interest margin continued to face headwinds from higher funding costs and lower reinvestment rates on maturing assets
